villagemaster/30462.htm.text: Grand Master Tronix: Welcome! Did Shilen, the Goddess of Dark Water, lead you to this place? No one comes to see me in a place like this without a pressing reason. Tell me, my young friend, what is your need?

links.text: Listen to information about first class transfer.
